newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee weak in dull Wenesday trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee weak in dull Wenesday trade.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee weakened slightly against the dollar in dull early Wednesday trade on lack of demand, dealers said.
At 0515 GMT, the rupees was trading around 58.45 after the Central Bank fixed buying and selling rates at 58.3927 and 59.5723, they said.
On Tuesday, the rupee closed firmer against the dollar at 58.40.
"Trading is dull. The market is not very active," said a foreign bank dealer.
A local bank leader said overnight call money rates opened at 12 percent and later fell to 11.25 percent.
